source.rule: Resolve vocabulary by textbook, grade and chronological unit position; canonical v7 is primary. Explicit earlier app/textbook-reviewed allowedWords is valid cumulative evidence when a word is not separately exposed as a keyword row. Never use a later section as evidence for an earlier passage.

resolutions.appFinding: The current Get Ready 4 passage uses play but its allowedWords metadata omitted play.
resolutions.repair: Add play to reviewed allowedWords metadata; do not add an unknown-word note.

evidence.priorAllowedWords: grow / use / after / town / bicycle / flower / walk / ride / watch / read / clean / beautiful / many / sometimes / don’t / at home / very much / after school
evidence.priorAuditNote: PROGRAM 2-1 reviewed id185-202; id203 begins PROGRAM 2-2
evidence.currentSectionAllowedWords: PROGRAM 2-2 explicitly carries PROGRAM 2-1 vocabulary cumulatively, but town itself was not repeated in the local list

resolutions.appFinding: The first scanner re-flagged town in PROGRAM 2-2 because it compared against only the current passage allowedWords. PROGRAM 2-1 had already explicitly reviewed and allowed town.
resolutions.repair: No passage rewrite and no unknown-word note. The scanner was corrected to accumulate only current and prior reviewed sections for the same textbook and grade; future sections remain excluded.

resolutions.appFinding: Unit 2-2 used 'At school, I give a short speech about local food.' before the v7 first appearance of give in Let's Read 1.
resolutions.repair: Replaced with prior-reviewed 'At school, I talk about local food in a short speech.' and synchronized fullTranslation, slashRows[0], A1 evidence/evidenceJp/reason. No unknown-word note added.

policy.futureWord: Rewrite to an already-learned word when natural.
policy.indispensableUnknown: Keep only when necessary and attach English/Japanese gloss from the v7 master or another explicit verified source.
policy.morphology: A known base form is not enough; the inflected form must also pass the grammar chronology gate.
policy.properNoun: Do not auto-approve merely because capitalization suggests a proper noun.
policy.priorReviewedCumulative: Earlier explicit reviewed vocabulary in the same textbook and grade may satisfy cumulative vocabulary chronology; later sections must never satisfy an earlier passage.
